newsitem.title: GREECE: Bank/Greece sells $80mln, 590mln ecus, drachma firms.
newsitem.headline: Bank/Greece sells $80mln, 590mln ecus, drachma firms.

text.p: Bank of Greece, the country's central bank, intervened again at the fixing on Thursday, selling aggressively $80 million and 590 million ecus and driving the ecu/drachma to 312 from 312.42, traders said.

"The central bank opened ecu/drachma at 312.42 and kept on selling ecus aggressively to drive it lower to 312," a dealer at a foreign bank said. "It sold 590 million ecus and $80 million for drachmas."
Dealers said the central bank also sold 35 million marks for drachmas and mark/drachma settled at 160.20.
The central bank sold 200 million ecus and 80 million marks for drachmas on Wednesday and 350 million ecus on Tuesday.

The drachma opened weak against the ecu on Thursday, trading around 312.50/70 but gathered some strength to 312.30/40 after the central bank checked $/drachma rates but lost ground again at mid-session to trade around 312.50 traders said.
A London-based German bank sold about 100 million marks for drachmas driving mark/drachma and ecu/drachma lower after mid-session, they said.

Ecu/drachma settled at 312 at the fixing on Thursday, marginally higher than Wednesday's 311.90. Mark/drachma stood at 160.200, up from 160.135 on Wednesday. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
